cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(SdkMetadataDiagnostic LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_QUIET TRUE)
foreach(index RANGE 1 24)
  check_cxx_source_compiles("int main() { return ${index} == ${index} ? 0 : 1; }" SDK_METADATA_${index})
  if(NOT SDK_METADATA_${index})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Actual compiler feature check failed")
  endif()
endforeach()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/diagnostic.cpp" "int main() { return 0; }\n")
add_executable(diagnostic "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/diagnostic.cpp")
